We host shows on Friday and Saturday nights, made up of performing groups from the attendees. On Friday, we ask the weekend’s teachers and organisers to perform. On Saturday, attending groups put on shows, plus The Ensemble, which is formed at BIP and coached on a brand new-to-them format during the Saturday sessions.

Friday Night Entertainment

French Toast!

Gooey, delicious and bad for your health. A dreamlike montage, but made of those slightly stressful dreams where everyone is staring at you and muttering. Presented by Alex, Bobby and Jen.

Still Family

After a major event reshapes their lives, a community gathers—each carrying a different version of what happened.

Still Family explores how the same moment can mean entirely different things to the people who lived it, and what it takes to remain connected.

Clown Court

A courtroom drama narrative format that rewards big swings and even bigger characters. See us go bigger, bolder, and clownier on stage as we turn petty grievances into full courtroom chaos.

Saturday Night Entertainment

Storytime with The Dingbats

Veteran Dingbats improvisers Harry, Aimee, Liam and Fin are just champing at the bit to show off some narrative improv. These stories will be full to the brim with twists and turns of which you’ve never seen the like. There will be a beginning. There will be a middle. Heck, there’ll even be an end. By injecting their solid foundation in longform improv with bold narrative turning points, these utter Dingbats ensure a fun-filled act for the whole family (or just you, if you didn’t bring your family. That’s fine too.)

Triple Threat

Three musicals enter, one musical leaves! BIP musical improv allstars present scenes from three musicals in different styles, but each round, one storyline is eliminated based on a very scientific cheer-off. Which musical will earn a grand ensemble finish? Only you can decide!

Leamprov Presents: Stories from the Sofa

Welcome to our living room! Pull up a chair and make yourself at home as our cast settle in for a chat. Inspired by your suggestions, we will have a free-flowing, unfiltered on-stage conversation that at any moment could turn into a spontaneous improv scene! Just like a cosy evening in with the funniest people you know, who knows where the conversation – and the comedy – will take us?

Ensemble: Blind Date

We all know the short form game “Blind Date”, but have you ever wondered what happened on the date? This ensemble show will give the audience the full TV show experience!
